REGRESSION FIXTURE — bob-workspace-compose render-safety guard (2026-06-17).
This config is STRUCTURALLY VALID (passes the schema-only check, --no-render-check)
but DOES NOT RENDER: the 'Team Overview' nav item below uses a free-form id
('myteam.overview') that is NOT a built surface, NOT an entityKey item, NOT a
'planner.*' key, NOT registered under navigation.secondaryTabs, AND has no
matching 'dashboards' entry. So when the user clicks it, the plugin's render()
dispatch (mode -> resolveSurfaceConfig -> route -> SECONDARY_TABS -> entityKey ->
custom.) falls through every branch to renderComingSoon() — a dead 'coming soon'
screen the user cannot use. This is exactly the class of bug the owner hit on
2026-06-17, where the validate/re-validate step passed schema validity but the
workspace did not render.

NOTE the contrast: if you ADD a 'dashboards["myteam.overview"]' entry, the id
becomes reachable (branch 1 renders that config) and the guard passes — that is
the correct fix and the reason the live config's free-form 'workspace.base-links'
nav id is fine (it has a matching dashboards entry).

Expected: `validate_workspace.py` reports 1 ERROR for the unreachable nav item
with the render guard on (default), and 0 errors with --no-render-check (proving
schema validity alone is not a sufficient guard).

items.label: Team Overview
items.desc: Custom team view — looks fine in JSON, renders a dead screen because nothing resolves this id.
